comment: Companion to teen-enrollment-restriction-android-for-work.json: blocks the legacy Android
device administrator enrollment path for teens too, so no Android MDM enrollment route is left
open. Teens stay on MAM-only app protection (android-app-protection-baseline.json), same as
adults. Priority is 3, not 2: priority must be unique per platformType, and priority 2 is
already held by adult-enrollment-restriction-android.json for this platformType.
name: teen-enrollment-restriction-android
